ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 5:95 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-contrast white focal points are spatially mapped along the trailing edge and lateral tips; discrete linear high-intensity disruptions are mapped on the interior left and center-right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude spikes ranging from 8 to 18 pixels; continuous jagged profile isolated along the posterior boundary from tip to notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward curvature on the distal lateral edges, transitioning to a concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered high-contrast white circular pixel groups (1-5 pixel radius) localized on the trailing edge peaks and the extreme lateral termini of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent parallel diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) on the mid-section of the left lobe; secondary vertical high-intensity scratch detected on the right lobe adjacent to the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive diagonal rake marks on the left lobe and dense barnacle colonization/scarring along the entire posterior margin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white 'tipping' effect on the lateral extremities caused by concentrated shell-based growth against the dark fluke background.
